//: The Daily Suitcase's items (docs/daily-suitcase.md), read by tools/art/pictures.py into the catalogue's `items` and `suitcases`. An item's id never changes; `standin` is the library square it borrows until its own picture is drawn. `suitcases`: each month's theme and its table's id (public/art/tables/tables.json). `events`: each two-week VIP event's theme and its table (docs/vip.md); its items carry `event` in place of `month`.

items.title: Bran Castle
items.prompt: A little painted miniature diorama, like a handmade souvenir model standing on its own small rounded island of earth and moss, at dusk: a soft painted 3D finish, chunky simple shapes, smooth shading, crisp clean edges, warm glowing lights, spooky but friendly and cheerful. A big round pumpkin-orange full moon stands just behind it as part of the model, and one small round friendly white ghost with two dot eyes floats beside it. The miniature: Bran Castle in Romania, 'Dracula's Castle': a white-walled castle with steep red-tiled roofs and towers of different heights, perched on a steep rocky crag above a few dark pines, its small windows glowing warm, two little bats. One object only, centred, filling most of the frame, seen from the front at a slight angle from above. No text, letters, numbers, logos or brands anywhere. No background, no floor, no shadow: isolated on a transparent background.
